purpose: Perform exactly one read-only observation of an offline-equivalent Docker Desktop/WSL baseline without relabeling an unclassified Docker Desktop CLI error as stopped.

official_semantics.docker_desktop_cli: Docker Desktop CLI documents status as reporting running or stopped and stop as a synchronous stop unless detached.
official_semantics.wsl: Microsoft documents wsl --shutdown as terminating all running distributions and the WSL 2 utility VM; list --running is the supported running-distribution observation surface.

allowed_command_sequence: snapshot A: PowerShell exact-name Docker runtime process inventory returning names only
snapshot B stability barrier: docker version --format {{json .Server}}
snapshot B stability barrier: PowerShell exact-name Docker runtime process inventory returning names only
non_command_observations: After each daemon CLI query, WaitNamedPipeW with zero timeout must return false with Win32 ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND (2) for dockerDesktopLinuxEngine; no pipe connection is opened.

admission_conditions.docker_desktop_status_lane: advisory_only; RUNNING blocks; exact STOPPED or unclassified nonzero may continue only when every independent lane passes
admission_conditions.wsl_inventory: strict complete parse; docker-desktop exists and is Stopped; every listed distribution is Stopped
admission_conditions.wsl_running_inventory: strict complete quiet parse with zero running distribution names
admission_conditions.desktop_linux_daemon: Docker CLI specifically unavailable plus two independent WaitNamedPipeW observations returning Win32 ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND (2)
admission_conditions.docker_runtime_process_inventory: strict JSON parse with zero allowlisted runtime process names
admission_conditions.stability_barrier: snapshots A and B must each pass every lane and produce identical strict WSL and process inventories
admission_conditions.attempt003_pre_gate_replay: A PASS observation is insufficient by itself; the separately audited attempt-003 runner must replay the offline-equivalent pre-gate immediately before its one start attempt.

forbidden: container create, run, stop, remove or exec
failure_policy: Any command timeout, spawn error, incomplete parser, running signal, reachable daemon, remaining target runtime process, permission-shaped daemon failure, or output ambiguity fails closed. No retry and no state mutation.
